title: plugin-auth: POST /auth/change-email to the caller's current address answers 400 {"message":"Email is the same"} with no error code
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZZ5q3itDsK1WDVLyQ

立卡门: ① 产品缺陷，具名落点 + 复现（reach: HTTP，`POST /api/v1/auth/change-email`，实测）
业务理由: 账户设置页和集成方按错误码分支处理拒绝（ADR-0112 错误码账本），这一条拒绝只有一句英文 message、没有 `code`，客户端只能按字符串匹配或当未知错误显示，也无法本地化；同接口的其它拒绝都带码。属于 #24243 那一类「上游抛错未盖码」的漏网。
动手的读者: 拥有 `packages/plugins/plugin-auth` 的车道：把这条上游拒绝纳入 plugin-auth 的无码拒绝映射，给出账本内的码（如 VALIDATION_FAILED 或专用码）。
查重: `change-email "Email is the same"` 13 命中（无相关）、`change-email no code refusal` 96（含已关）；最近邻 #24243、#24254（别的无码 hook 拒绝，已关），不是本条。
Batch-of: release-18.3.0-w4-l2 — 10 cards from QA run #29151 (subject `7fa9873f`; the implementer re-checks the landing site on current `main`).

QA-source: #29151 · identity-auth.auth-method-matrix · observed beside the clauses

## What happens
Signed in as any user, `POST /api/v1/auth/change-email {"newEmail":"OWN_CURRENT_ADDRESS"}` answers 400 with body `{"message":"Email is the same"}` and no `code`. Other refusals on the same door carry one (VALIDATION_ERROR, UNAUTHORIZED).

Measured at framework `7fa9873f` (main, 2026-11-02) on a stock showcase boot.

## Reproduction
1. Boot the showcase; sign in as any user.
2. `POST /api/v1/auth/change-email` with `newEmail` set to the caller's own address.
3. **Expected:** 400 with a ledgered `code`.
4. **Actual:** 400 `{"message":"Email is the same"}`, no code.

## Mechanism (read at 7fa9873f)
The vendor throws `APIError.fromStatus("BAD_REQUEST", {message})` (`better-auth/dist/api/routes/update-user.mjs:437`), and plugin-auth's code-less refusal mapping (the #24243 class) does not stamp it.
